products.color: Region Jacket - Dusty Black Dense Cotton
products.description: Crafted from a cotton twill with water resistant coating and a dry hand feel, in a worn black. The Region Jacket is knee length with a relaxed fit and raglan sleeves. Featuring a storm placket with button loop fastening, two-way zip, front flap pockets, adjustable tab at cuffs, an interior pocket and adjustable strings at waist and hem. This garment is made from carefully sourced natural material and treated using a process that gives each piece its own individual shade and character. Variations are intentional and part of the garment’s identity. With time and wear, the garment will naturally evolve, taking on unique characteristics.
